content: Go git subprocess: use exec.CommandContext(ctx, 'git', args...) - never shell string injection. Pass args separately to avoid command injection. Capture stderr with cmd.Stderr = &stderrBuf or CombinedOutput for diagnostics. Set WaitDelay (Go 1.20+) to avoid hanging forever if git subprocess leaves children. Use context.WithTimeout for bounding git operations. Set cmd.Dir to repo root. Set GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE env vars if needed. Run git plumbing commands (diff-index, diff-files, ls-files) not porcelain for stability.
